text: {Name}, a former foundry worker from {Place}, served in the army. After a superior threatened death for refusing, the soldier helped execute prisoners and later admitted taking part.
self_review: A former foundry worker served in the army, helped execute prisoners after a superior threatened death for refusal, and later admitted participation.
source_pattern: The supplied Erdemovic sentencing summary records participation in executions under a threat of death, a guilty plea, and treatment of duress as mitigation rather than exoneration.
fictional_changes: The foundry work, character, and conflict are invented; only the general pressure-choice-admission pattern is retained. No real victim, execution site, date, or sentence is copied.
